aiResearchSummary.text: JetPack Aviation is focused on developing jet-powered aircraft, as evidenced by their work on a frame member integrated with at least one jet engine. This engine features a thrust discharge axis, a connector portion, and a discharge opening, all designed to optimize thrust along the engine's axis. The engine is securely mounted on the frame, indicating a focus on stability and efficiency in jet propulsion systems. This research highlights JetPack Aviation's commitment to advancing jetpack technology through innovative design and engineering.
